title: Content Marketing for Small Business: An Actionable Guide

facts.fact: According to Servicedirect (2022), only 57% of 702 small businesses surveyed (60% B2C vs. 40% B2B) report doing any content marketing.
facts.quote: Only 57% of 702 small businesses surveyed (60% B2C vs. 40% B2B) report doing any content marketing.

facts.fact: According to Servicedirect (2022), 44% of surveyed respondents said generating new customers was their primary goal.
facts.quote: 44% of respondents said generating new customers was the primary goal

facts.fact: According to Servicedirect (2022), 33% of surveyed respondents hoped to improve customer retention and loyalty.
facts.quote: 33% hoped to improve customer retention and loyalty

facts.fact: According to Servicedirect (2022), 20% of surveyed respondents wanted to increase brand awareness.
The Webnode article "Content Marketing for Small Business: A Guide to Getting Relevant Leads" is dated January 20, 2026.
